import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import konumsal as ko
import uzaysal as uz
In [2]:
I = plt.imread("../data/sekil-01.png")[:, :, :3]
J = ko.cevirme(I, axis=0)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.imshow(I)

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.imshow(J)

plt.show()

In [11]:
I = plt.imread("../data/rose.png")[:, :, :3]

xy = np.array([[5, 30, 5], 
               [5, 5, 30], 
               [1, 1, 1]])

uv = np.array([[140, 150, 130], 
               [10, 20, 40], 
               [1, 1, 1]])

A = uz.transform_matrix(xy, uv)
J = uz.andıran(I, A=A)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.imshow(I)
plt.plot(xy[0], xy[1], 'r*')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.imshow(J)
plt.plot(uv[0], uv[1], 'r*')

plt.show()
